t: This is Chalk Farm tube station, on the Edgware branch of the Northern line between Belsize Park and Camden Town. It sits in fare zone 2, and with slightly under five million entries and exits in 2011 it's one of the busiest stations on that branch. The architect was Leslie Green, best known for the Underground stations he designed in the first decade of the twentieth century, with oxblood red faience blocks, semicircular first-floor windows and patterned tiled interiors. The painter Sarah Cunningham, known for her large landscapes, died here.
